title: Stationary objects over Montana written off as Soviet surveillance

tellings.quote: The rumors were they're probably Soviet surveillance planes. Surveillance planes, you know, and the controller told me they were basically stationary. You know, are the Soviets flying helicopters over Montana? I don't think so.

plain: Objects hung almost still in the sky over Montana, and at the time people put them down as Soviet spy planes. A man named Robert Hastings tells it, passing on what a radar controller told him: the rumour was "Soviet surveillance planes," but the controller said they were "basically stationary." Hastings finds that explanation unlikely ("are the Soviets flying helicopters over Montana? I don't think so"), which would leave the objects unexplained.
